A '''waltz''' was a type of [[Music/Legends|music]] or [[dance]]. [[Nabicci Futana]] composed waltzes, many of which the [[Imperial Symphony Orchestra]] was scheduled to perform during its [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] tour beginning in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
